task_description: Import CFA Corporate Issuers practice questions (158 questions across 7 modules) and build a comprehensive attempt tracking system with enhanced dashboard showing circular progress rings, topic-wise accuracy breakdown, confidence indicators, review mode with bookmarks and explanations, and retake comparison tracking.

verification.summary: TypeScript compiles with only 2 pre-existing Prisma errors. All 38 new/existing tests pass (2 pre-existing env.test.ts failures from zod v4 API mismatch are unrelated). New test file has 23 comprehensive tests covering attempt storage CRUD, seed correctness, question data validation.
